title: Hydrocele
summary: HY'DROCELE, noun [Gr. water, and tumor.] Any hernia proceeding from water; a watery tumor, particularly one in the scrotum. A dropsy of the scrotum.

inlines.v: HY'DROCELE, noun [Gr. water, and tumor.] Any hernia proceeding from water; a watery tumor, particularly one in the scrotum. A dropsy of the scrotum.
